import java.lang.ref.WeakReference;
public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] a) {
        Object o = new byte[1 << 20];
        WeakReference<Object> w = new WeakReference<>(o);
        o = null;
        System.gc();
        System.out.println(w.get() == null ? "collected" : "retained");
    }
}
